issue_request: FHIR-25934 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Provenance. It asked whether Provenance.agent.onBehalfOf duplicated organizations represented through agent.who when who is a Device or PractitionerRole, and resolved to keep onBehalfOf for delegation, clarify who/onBehalfOf definitions, and remove obsolete whoIdentity/onBehalfOfIdentity comments.
